core_obligations: Reduce to X = Spec(A) affine (the statement is local and both sides glue).
K in D^-_Coh is pseudo-coherent by the Noetherian identification; translate R SheafHom(K, L) into the algebra problem via the quasi-coherence lemma.
For L in D^+_Coh, K in D^-_Coh, run the convergent spectral sequence Ext^p_A(K, H^q(L)) => Ext^{p+q}_A(K, L).
Run the second spectral sequence Ext^i_A(H^{-j}(K), H^q(L)) => Ext^{i+j}_A(K, H^q(L)); each entry is finite by the Noetherian Ext-finiteness lemma since the H-bullet terms are finite.
Conclude Ext^{p+q}_A(K, L) is finite for all degrees, i.e., R Hom_A(K, L) in D^+_Coh(A); transport back to the sheaf statement.
proof_roadmap: Affine reduction; algebra translation; two spectral sequences; Noetherian Ext finiteness; transport back.
difficulty_reason: A two-spectral-sequence coherence argument; the entries are finite by a named Noetherian input.
